cd /tmp/ws && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import parse

# Test standalone alignment patterns
tests = [
    ("{:<}", "hello world"),
    ("{:^}", "hello world"),
    ("{:>}", "hello world"),
]

for pattern, string in tests:
    p = parse.compile(pattern)
    print(f"Pattern {pattern}: {p._expression}")
    
    r = p.parse(string)
    print(f"parse: {r}")
    
    r2 = p.search(string)
    print(f"search: {r2}")
    print()
PYEOF
